set.notes: [V16-B2 citation upgrade institutional_archive -> PMID: 23997672 as part of Mathews node consolidation] Mathews served as the first president and primary founder of the American Proctologic Society. Content-match confirmed: Schoetz DJ. 'The American Board of Colon and Rectal Surgery: past, present, future.' Clin Colon Rectal Surg. 2012;25:166-170 (PMID 23997672) states the APS was founded by 13 surgeons led by Mathews at Columbus Ohio in 1899. This is the surviving society_founder edge after the duplicate Joseph M. Mathews -> APS society_founder edge (also PMID 23997672) was deleted in the same batch.
